thread:
maria: Quick check — planning to enable the model_v5_2 canary flag tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need a short ops plan: region split (NA/EU/APAC), percent steps, exclusion lists, and abort guardrails. ETA on review?

ajay: I can own the flag flip. do we have the percent schedule? also need to confirm any VIP customers to exclude.

maria: Proposed schedule: start at 0.5% global (split 0.2% NA / 0.2% EU / 0.1% APAC) for 30m sanity, then 2% per region over 6h to reach 5% each, then 24h observation -> 10% burst if stable. Open to adjustments.

kevin: Re: guardrails — please auto-abort if 95th latency increases >30% or error rate >0.5% absolute or subjective quality regression on eval set crosses threshold. Can we wire immediate rollback?

ajay: Yep, flagroll supports automated abort hooks. I'll add three checks: latency_pct95, error_rate, eval_drift. If any triggers, it flips to fallback model and pages-oncall.

sara: Who's oncall during that window? need explicit pager add and runbook link in the thread. Also, let's exclude accounts in "enterprise-exempt" segment (billing/legal flagged).

maria: Oncall for that window: @kevin on primary, @sara backup. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/inference/rollouts/playbook (see section "canary fast abort"). Exempt list: enterprise-exempt tag in flagroll.

kevin: I'll add the abort hook to the release checklist. Also recommend a small canary prompt set (50 queries) for manual quality checks at 1% and 5%. Who can own that?

maria: I'll coordinate a quick eval with ML QA. Ajay, add the webhook to post eval results to #eng-ml.

ajay: done — webhook added. sample flag config below:

```json
{
  "flag": "model_v5_2_canary",
  "phases": [
    {"duration": "30m", "targets": {"na": 0.2, "eu": 0.2, "apac": 0.1}},
    {"duration": "6h", "ramp": {"na": 2, "eu": 2, "apac": 2}},
    {"duration": "24h", "observe": true}
  ],
  "exclusions": ["enterprise-exempt"],
  "abort_conditions": ["latency_pct95>30%", "error_rate>0.5%", "eval_drift>threshold"]
}
```

release-bot: preflight checks passed: infra-health OK, model-artifact signed, metrics-dashboard present. No immediate blockers.

sara: quick ops question — do we need a regional toggle as a backup (flip EU only) or will flagroll handle per-region rollback?

ajay: flagroll can flip per-region independently. I'll prepare separate per-region toggles in case we need targeted cutover.

kevin: Logging/trace hooks: make sure the new decoder path is tagged as model_v5_2 in traces and in perf metrics. Otherwise we won't be able to attribute regressions.

maria: Good call. Ajay add tags, and ML QA will include decode-path label in their eval results.

ajay: tagging in place. Also added a canary label in datadog: inference.model:canary=v5_2.

maria: Final ask — please confirm ownership and post the time we'll flip. If everything's green we'll go tomorrow 09:00 PST.

kevin: I'm primary during flip. I'll monitor dashboards and be ready to hit abort.

sara: I'm backup and will watch the quality channel.

ajay: I'll start the staged toggle job at 09:00 PST and monitor hook outputs. I'll post here when each phase completes. :rocket:

maria: Thanks all — leaving this thread pinned to the release card. Ping me in thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
